conclusions: The local Node22 candidate invokes the callback synchronously within the input store and forwards object/Promise identities through the saved lX wrapper.
A synchronous callback throw propagates as the same Error while restoring the caller outer store; nested normal runs also restore the outer store.
run returns a pending callback Promise immediately, restoring synchronous scope before fulfillment/rejection. Promise settlement and source-local await/catch are separate facts.
Promise continuations created inside local run retain their creation store after run synchronously exits; nested inner/outer-created work keeps its respective store.
